title: Selling Plans Chargeback Credits — Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) Relief
content:
When a charged-back order was shipped from the Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) network, the administration fee withheld from the **Selling Plans** chargeback credit is relieved by a fixed amount. The relief reads the outbound shipment recorded for the order in the seller's FBN activity.

**Rule.** The FBN chargeback relief is the same-day FBN chargeback relief when the order's FBN outbound shipment is dated the same calendar day as the order's variable fee record, the FBN chargeback relief when the order's FBN outbound shipment is dated later, and nothing when the order has no FBN outbound shipment. The FBN chargeback relief is subtracted after the cap and never takes the fee below zero.

| FBN outbound shipment of the charged-back order | Relief subtracted from the administration fee |
|---|---|
| Dated the same calendar day as the variable fee record | USD 3.00 (same-day FBN chargeback relief) |
| Dated a later day | USD 1.50 (FBN chargeback relief) |
| None recorded | Nothing |

## Order of operations, shown on hypothetical figures

| Administration fee after the cap | Relief | Fee withheld |
|---|---|---|
| USD 5.00 | USD 3.00 | USD 2.00 |
| USD 5.00 | USD 1.50 | USD 3.50 |
| USD 2.20 | USD 3.00 | USD 0.00 — never below zero |
| USD 10.00 (held from USD 12.40) | USD 1.50 | USD 8.50 — the relief is taken from the capped figure |
